tasks.prompt: test_exact_report passes when I run it on its own but fails when I run the whole test suite. Find out why and fix it.

assertions.text: Names the cause: the mutable default list argument in build_report keeps lines from earlier calls.
Shows evidence for the cause, such as running the tests in both orders or reproducing the accumulated output, rather than only asserting it.
Fixes the function itself rather than changing the tests or their order.

tasks.prompt: The invoice tests fail with 'discount produced an invalid total' even in a test that applies no discount. Find the real cause and fix it.

assertions.text: Names the cause: binary floating-point addition makes 0.10 + 0.20 + 0.30 slightly more than 0.60, so the exact equality check fails; the discount logic is not at fault.
Shows evidence for the cause, such as the actual computed value, rather than only asserting it.
The fix handles money correctly in general, for example with Decimal, integer cents, or rounding before the comparison, rather than special-casing the test values.
